t: This is the London headquarters of Google DeepMind, an artificial intelligence research laboratory. It was founded in the UK in 2010, bought by Google in 2014, and joined with Google Brain in 2023 to take its current name. Three people founded it. Demis Hassabis is its chairman, and in 2024 he shared the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for work on protein structure prediction. Shane Legg is its chief AGI scientist. Mustafa Suleyman went on to co-found Inflection AI and is now CEO of Microsoft AI.
